chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Musa ibn Bakr who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: 'Frequent eating of eggs increases in offspring.'
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating eggs according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) links the frequent consumption of eggs to increased fertility, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating practical health advice with spiritual well-being. This hadith is often cited in discussions on *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine) to demonstrate how dietary habits can influence physical vitality and progeny, aligning with the holistic view of the body as an amanah (trust) from God.
